blocks.name: Left Arrow

blocks.name: Up Arrow

blocks.name: Right Arrow
blocks.behavior: Gravity arrow right. current (2,0), delayed (2,0), not rotated. below = (cx+1,cy). §4.4

blocks.name: Dot
blocks.behavior: Gravity dot: no gravity (current and delayed 0,0; rotation keeps 0). Flushes the delayed queue (§4.3). Ice below does not set slippery while current is 4. below = (cx,cy+1). §4.4

blocks.name: CROWN
blocks.behavior: Crown. Touch (entering, not flying): if !hascrown: removeCrown() (checkCrown(false)), hascrown = true, checkCrown(true) (deferred by overlap). Crown doors/gates 1094/1095. The tile stays. §5.3

blocks.name: EFFECT_JUMP
blocks.behavior: Jump effect. L: 0 normal, 1 high (x1.3), 2 low (x0.75). Touch: if L != jumpBoost: jumpBoost = L. §6

blocks.name: EFFECT_FLY
blocks.behavior: Fly (levitation) effect. L != 0 on. Touch: hasLevitation = L != 0 (off -> thrust 0). Holding jump thrusts instead of jumping. §6.3

blocks.name: EFFECT_RUN
blocks.behavior: Speed effect. L: 0 normal, 1 fast (x1.5), 2 slow (x0.6) on mx,my. §6

blocks.name: EFFECT_PROTECTION
blocks.behavior: Protection effect. L != 0 on. Turning on clears curse, zombie, poison, fire. While on: no spike/fire/toxic death, no lava fire, no curse/zombie/poison pickup. §6

blocks.name: EFFECT_CURSE
blocks.behavior: Curse effect. L = seconds (0 = remove). Touch (not invulnerable, state differs): cursed; dies at t0 + floor((L+0.4)*100) + 1. Re-touch does not refresh. §6.2

blocks.name: EFFECT_ZOMBIE
blocks.behavior: Zombie effect. L = seconds (0 = remove). Zombie: speed x0.6, jump x0.75, zombie door 207 open / gate 206 closed; dies after the timer like curse. §6.2

blocks.name: EFFECT_TEAM
blocks.behavior: Team effect. L = team 0..6 (None, Red, Blue, Green, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow). Touch (entering, not flying): team = L if no overlap results; otherwise retried every tick at step c via the member tx/ty. Kept through respawn; resetPlayer sets 0. §6.4
